long_biography.plain_text:
Primat trained at racing schools in France and Britain after an early spell as a New York wealth-management analyst. His progression from Formula Ford and Formula Three led to international sports-car competition. Primat raced for Aston Martin and Rebellion, achieving his best Le Mans result in 2010.

Retirement shifted his attention back to capital allocation. As a member of Primwest’s family investment committee, he helps oversee a portfolio built from inherited Schlumberger wealth while pursuing his own early-stage investments in technology and consumer businesses. His current public work also includes the Fondation Didier et Martine Primat, which supports educational and environmental projects.
